lede: Baltimore Ravens carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#4 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Dallas Cowboys +1.6 with a fair total of 51.1 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Baltimore Ravens pass offence vs Dallas Cowboys pass defence, which sits +0.269 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Baltimore Ravens and Dallas Cowboys have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
